verdicts.reason: A: the hands photo is squeezed into a narrow, oddly cropped strip in the middle, and a white cloud block bites into its top-right corner. The left third is dead white space with ghostly cloud outlines, and the plus signs float loose. Still, the quote and attribution are readable, the hierarchy is clear and the key image survives. B: the white cloud panel covers almost all of the photo, leaving only a black L-shaped sliver, so the central praying-hands image is lost. The text sits on that panel, slightly off from the photo, the left side has the same empty white area, and the result no longer reads as the original design.
